meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以打开并操作一个浏览器，例如访问网址、点击元素、填写表单，也能截图和抓取网页数据。它会把页面状态保留下来，所以多步任务能分小步连续做。
howto.when: 当用户提出任何浏览器操作请求时触发，例如“打开某网址”“点击按钮”或“填写表单”。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com 并截一张图
say.note: 会打开网页并把截图保存到本地。

say.text: 在这个页面搜索“天气”并点击搜索按钮
say.note: 会先定位输入框，填入后点击搜索。

say.text: 抓取当前页面里所有文章标题
say.note: 会读取页面内容并返回标题列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can open and drive a browser, e.g. visit URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, and scrape page data. Page state is kept, so it can handle multi-step tasks in small consecutive steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered by any browser interaction request from the user, e.g., “go to [url]”, “click on”, “fill out the form”.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: It will open the page and save the screenshot locally.

say_en.text: Search for “weather” on this page and click the search button.
say_en.note: It locates the input, fills it, and clicks search.

say_en.text: Scrape all article titles on the current page and list them.
say_en.note: It reads the page and returns a title list.
